_comment: Where LaunchBox keeps a platform's pictures when they aren't under its own name (see platformIcon and platformLogo in server/lib/library.js). icons: the name of its icon in Images\Platform Icons\Platforms, where LaunchBox's icon set calls the platform something else. logos: for a platform with nothing in Images\Platforms\<platform>\Clear Logo, a logo from elsewhere in LaunchBox, relative to its folder; these come from theme folders, drawn on a canvas the size of the screen, and are trimmed to the logo itself. Only ones that read on the shelf's dark heading are listed.
